# OCAML03 toolchain evidence

This directory preserves the platform-specific solver locks and installed
package receipts for the OCaml scaffold fixtures. The two scaffold input opam
files are byte-identical, so each runner family has one shared dependency lock.
The platform directories remain separate because Windows adds MinGW host and
compiler packages even when the direct OCaml dependencies are unchanged.

The initial evidence was generated by GitHub Actions run `30597684930` from
commit `f0480b873bad29b07e1214c65287d8829967e2a4` against opam-repository commit
`ba8cc66eb9e5baae7ebc88cf77f4c488d63d87ff`. The permanent workflow regenerates
the same lock and receipt from an unlocked solve, uploads that fresh result for
inspection, and compares it byte-for-byte with these files before executing a
second locked-install job.

`runner_image` values in `toolchain-lock.json` record the mutable hosted image
that generated the initial evidence. They are diagnostic provenance, not a
trusted host identity or an immutable runner attestation.

To update the evidence after an intentional reviewed dependency or repository
change:

1. update OCAML03 and the exact identities in the validator, manifest, and
   workflow;
2. run the three-platform fresh-solve matrix;
3. download and review every uploaded lock, receipt, and runner-image record;
4. replace all three target directories and their manifest digests together;
5. run the locked fixture matrix and the offline validator; and
6. obtain a new security review before publication.
